title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
summary_lines: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
